bayesian_main_text_policy: Report the occupancy posterior and, if model comparison is mentioned, Delta ELPD-LOO with its SE. Do not lead with the grid Bayes factor.
recommended_model_framing: Use the Base model as a minimal mechanistic test model. Claim qualitative/topological sufficiency and a robust compatible dynamical regime; do not claim a complete quantitative population model or a uniquely recovered physiological prior.
next_action: Integrate the consolidated result into the manuscript and figures; do not add a new kinetic extension unless a new experimental constraint specifically motivates it.
